values.en: Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ be Euclidean open and $X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ be smooth and regular on $\Omega$. At $q\in\Omega$, put $U=X_u(q)$ and $V=X_v(q)$; these form a basis of $T_qX$. Choose a smooth unit normal field $\boldsymbol N:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ on $\Omega$ as in the normal context. Let $J\subseteq\mathbb R$ be an open interval, $\alpha=(u,v):J\to\Omega$ be $C^2$, and $\gamma=X\circ\alpha$. For every $t\in J$, $\langle\ddot\gamma(t),\boldsymbol N(\alpha(t))\rangle=\mathrm{II}_{X,\boldsymbol N}(\alpha(t);\dot\gamma(t),\dot\gamma(t))$. Thus the vector normal projection is this scalar times $\boldsymbol N(\alpha(t))$. This holds for arbitrary speed, even at zero velocity; neither regularity of the curve nor arc-length parametrization is assumed.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ 为欧氏开集，$X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ 在 $\Omega$ 上光滑且正则。取 $q\in\Omega$，记 $U=X_u(q)$、$V=X_v(q)$，它们构成 $T_qX$ 的一组基。选定法向语境中的光滑单位法向场 $\boldsymbol N:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$（条件只在 $\Omega$ 上要求）。设 $J\subseteq\mathbb R$ 为开区间，$\alpha=(u,v):J\to\Omega$ 为 $C^2$ 曲线，$\gamma=X\circ\alpha$。对每个 $t\in J$，$\langle\ddot\gamma(t),\boldsymbol N(\alpha(t))\rangle=\mathrm{II}_{X,\boldsymbol N}(\alpha(t);\dot\gamma(t),\dot\gamma(t))$。向量法投影等于该标量乘 $\boldsymbol N(\alpha(t))$。任意速乃至速度为零处均成立，不要求曲线正则，也不假定弧长参数。
